derivation:
by
  ext i j
  simpa [MvFormalGroup.linearPart, Series.id, Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm] using (MvPowerSeries.coeff_index_single_X (R := B) i j)
explanation: Mathlib states that the coefficient of X i at the single-variable index j is the Kronecker delta. Specializing to Fin 2 and unfolding the definitions gives exactly the identity matrix entrywise. The current proof instead uses a theorem from this library.
